items.title: How many days late does a delivery need to be before it fails the PIP's first expectation?
items.description: Drag how many days late the June 15 delivery ends up. L3's expectation 1 is specific and observable — ship on or before the stated date — so this isn't a sliding scale of partial credit: any lateness at all fails it, exactly as it does for the Scenario's Outcome B, where a 3-day slip with no advance flag counted as not met.

params.name: daysLate
params.label: Days late on the stated delivery date
